name: Runtime Upgrade and Migration Hooks
description: When the application upgrades, migration hooks run: database migrations, config migrations, state format migrations. Rollback on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration hooks are registered with version range and ordered by dependency
Each migration is transactional — failure triggers automatic rollback of that migration
Migration runner detects previous version and applies only unapplied migrations in order
Failed migration rolls back the complete migration chain, not just the failed step
Pre-upgrade snapshot of mutable state is taken before migration execution
Post-upgrade health check verifies migrated state is consistent
Migration logs are written for audit trail and post-mortem
required_evidence: Migration hook registration with version range and ordering test
Transactional migration with rollback on failure test
Only unapplied migrations run on upgrade test
Full chain rollback on mid-chain failure test
acceptance_gates: Migrations registered with version range and ordered by dependency
Each migration is transactional with rollback
Failed migration rolls back full chain
rollback_strategy: Full migration chain rollback on any step failure — restore pre-upgrade snapshot
recovery_strategy: Restore from pre-upgrade snapshot and retry migration with fixed version
escalation_policy: After max failed upgrade attempts, escalate to user with migration failure diagnostics
